{{Quote|I looked up from my research and found myself looking at Lutris Lake, and I don't have a window. My whole wall was gone by the time I could tell anyone.|Tynnan General Council Assistant Zobyteeg|<ref name="HNNews" />}}
'''Lutris''' was a locale on<ref name="HNNews" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]].<ref name="HNNews" /> Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE Razelfiin">{{CSWECite|III|84|Razelfiin}}</ref> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Tynna Central Government Building]], which was sited in Lutris near [[Lutris Lake]], collapsed due to a [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mite]] infestation. [[General Council Assistant]] [[Zobyteeg]] alerted local security to the building's state, after which the premises were evacuated. The incident prompted [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] planetary leader [[Razelfiin]] to voice dissatisfaction on a lack of intervention from the Republic or the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]], and her intention to contact<ref name="HNNews" /> Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]]<ref name= "AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] when a new seat of government could be established. The events in Lutris, and interviews therein with Zobyteeg and Razelfiin, were featured in the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] with the headline "Tynna to Secede Following Building Disappearance."<ref name="HNNews" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lutris was featured on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] in the [[in-universe]] issue [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 53|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #53'']], published<ref name="HNNews" /> on [[April 25]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN53 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6586618|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Mastadge|date=2002-04-25|time=5:54 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> and written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
